columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_rotation_mode
columns.comment: The ad rotation mode of the ad group.

columns.name: ad_group_cpc_bid_micros
columns.comment: The maximum CPC (cost-per-click) bid.

columns.name: ad_group_cpm_bid_micros
columns.comment: The maximum CPM (cost-per-thousand viewable impressions) bid.

columns.name: ad_group_cpv_bid_micros
columns.comment: The CPV (cost-per-view) bid.

columns.name: ad_group_display_custom_bid_dimension
columns.comment: Allows advertisers to specify a targeting dimension on which to place absolute bids. This is only applicable for campaigns that target only the display network and not search.

columns.name: ad_group_effective_target_cpa_micros
columns.comment: The effective target CPA (cost-per-acquisition). This field is read-only.

columns.name: ad_group_effective_target_cpa_source
columns.comment: Source of the effective target CPA. This field is read-only.

columns.name: ad_group_effective_target_roas
columns.comment: The effective target ROAS (return-on-ad-spend). This field is read-only.

columns.name: ad_group_effective_target_roas_source
columns.comment: Source of the effective target ROAS. This field is read-only.

columns.name: ad_group_name
columns.comment: The name of the ad group. This field is required and should not be empty when creating new ad groups. It must contain fewer than 255 UTF-8 full-width characters. It must not contain any null (code point 0x0), NL line feed (code point 0xA) or carriage return (code point 0xD) characters.

columns.name: ad_group_status
columns.comment: The status of the ad group.

columns.name: ad_group_tracking_url_template
columns.comment: The URL template for constructing a tracking URL.

columns.name: ad_group_type
columns.comment: The type of the ad group.

columns.name: ad_group_url_custom_parameters
columns.comment: The list of mappings used to substitute custom parameter tags in a `tracking_url_template`, `final_urls`, or `mobile_final_urls`.

columns.name: campaign_bidding_strategy
columns.comment: Portfolio bidding strategy used by campaign.

columns.name: campaign_bidding_strategy_type
columns.comment: The type of bidding strategy. A bidding strategy can be created by setting either the bidding scheme to create a standard bidding strategy or the `bidding_strategy` field to create a portfolio bidding strategy. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_manual_cpc_enhanced_cpc_enabled
columns.comment: Whether bids are to be enhanced based on conversion optimizer data.

columns.name: campaign_percent_cpc_enhanced_cpc_enabled
columns.comment: Adjusts the bid for each auction upward or downward, depending on the likelihood of a conversion. Individual bids may exceed cpc_bid_ceiling_micros, but the average bid amount for a campaign should not.
